changelog: **Self-serve signup flow and first-run panel (#1751):** a public `/signup` page (EN/TR/DE, INTERNSHIP only) posts to `POST /api/public/signup/org` and ends in a "check your email" state — never a session. It states the Community terms from the price list (active pairs, admin seats, no card) and that mentors and mentees are free forever. With `SELF_SERVE_SIGNUP` off it renders an honest "opening soon" state with the enquiry form as the way in, and the client falls back to it on a 503 `not_enabled`. While the flag is on, the public header gets a "Start free" link and the pricing page's Community column opens `/signup`. A tenant with no mentorship relation sees a three-step first-run panel on `/admin` (invite mentors, invite mentees, first pairing) instead of empty lists; it renders links only and disappears after the first pairing. `/admin/invite?role=MENTOR` preselects the role.

en: A brand-new organization now opens on a three-step guide to its first mentor–mentee pair instead of empty lists.
tr: Yeni açılan bir organizasyon artık boş listeler yerine ilk mentor–mentee eşleşmesine giden üç adımlık bir rehberle açılıyor.
de: Eine neue Organisation öffnet jetzt mit einer Drei-Schritte-Anleitung zum ersten Mentor–Mentee-Paar statt mit leeren Listen.
